case_name: Sri K Raghu vs Smt S N Shruthi
facts_of_case: The parties are husband and wife who sought dissolution of marriage under Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking dissolution of marriage to prove that the respondent has not been living with him for at least three years immediately preceding the petition.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the burden lies on the party seeking dissolution of marriage to prove that the respondent has not been living with him for at least three years immediately preceding the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not interfere with the personal liberty of a party unless there is a clear and compelling reason to do so.
legal_principles.held: This Court will not interfere with the personal liberty of a party unless there is a clear and compelling reason to do so.

outcome.final_order: The appeal is dismissed as not pressed, and the application for condonation of delay is also dismissed.
